title: Preparation of mineralised matrices secreted from human primary osteoblasts for analysis of the interaction of cancer cells and the bone microenvironment
protocol: Collect samples under sterile conditions.
Harvest non-sclerotic, trabecular bone using a bone curette and transfer to sterile 50 ml tubes.
Wash and vortex trabecular bone with PBS for a minimum of 5 times until the PBS remains clear.
Incubate trabecular bone with trypsin (0.25%)-EDTA for 3 min at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Add growth medium to inactivate trypsin.
Wash samples once with PBS.
Transfer trabecular bone to tissue culture flasks and top up with growth medium.
Culture at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Observe osteoblast outgrowth after 5-7 days.
Use cells expanded to the second or third passage for experiments.
Detach hOBs with trypsin (0.25%)-EDTA (4-5 ml per 175 cm² tissue culture flask).
Add 10 ml of growth media to inactivate trypsin.
Transfer cells to a 15 ml disposable plastic tube and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 min.
Resuspend cells in 10 ml of growth medium.
Remove an aliquot of cells for counting.
Plate hOBs at a density of 3000 cells/cm² in growth media.
Grow hOBs at 37°C in 5% CO₂ until confluent, changing the media every 3-4 days.
Change the medium to differentiation medium when confluent.
Culture for 4 weeks to allow secretion of mineralized matrix, changing media every 3-4 days.
Aspirate culture medium.
Rinse by adding 1 ml sterile dH₂O.
Aspirate the liquid carefully with a standard pipettor using a 1000 μl tip.
Add 1 ml of 20 mM ammonium hydroxide to each well.
Incubate at room temperature with occasional gentle agitation.
Check the status of the cultures microscopically at intervals during the lysis to determine the extent of cellular removal.
Rinse OBM twice carefully and quickly with approximately 1 ml sterile dH₂O.
Rinse OBM twice as above carefully and quickly with approximately 1 ml PBS.
Carefully aspirate PBS from OBM.
For a 24-well plate, add 1 ml of 4% PFA in PBS.
Incubate at room temperature for 20 min with gentle rocking.
Rinse the OBM twice with 1 ml PBS.
Add 1 ml PBS.
Store at 4°C.
Culture osteoblasts on round thermanox coverslips inserted into wells of a 6 or 24 well plate.
Fix samples with glutaraldehyde fixative at 4°C overnight.
Wash samples three times for 10 min in 0.1M sodium cacodylate buffer in dH₂O, pH 7.4.
Fix samples in osmium tetroxide solution for 1 h.
Incubate samples two times for 10 min in dH₂O.
Incubate samples two times for 10 min in 50% ethanol.
Incubate samples two times for 10 min in 70% ethanol.
Incubate samples two times for 10 min in 90% ethanol.
Incubate samples two times for 15 min in 100% ethanol.
Incubate samples two times for 15 min in 100% amyl acetate.
Critical point dry samples.
Mount samples on SEM stubs.
Coat samples with gold using sputter coater.
Store gold-coated samples in desiccator until analysis.
Remove PFA-fixed matrices from 4°C.
Add 1 ml of 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS per well to the matrix in a 24-well plate.
Incubate for 20 min at room temperature with gentle rocking.
Wash samples twice for 5 min with 1 ml PBS at room temperature with gentle rocking.
Add 700 μl of DAPI staining solution to each well (24 well plate).
Incubate for 40-50 min at room temperature on shaker.
Wash twice for 5 min with 1 ml PBS at room temperature with gentle rocking.
Visualise with a fluorescent microscope.
Remove PFA-fixed matrices from 4°C.
Rinse with 1 ml PBS (24 well plate).
Add 0.5 ml Alizarin S staining solution.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min with gentle rocking.
Thoroughly wash excess dye from the wells with dH₂O.
Visualise samples with light microscopy for red stained calcified regions.
Remove PFA-fixed matrices from 4°C.
Rinse twice with PBS.
Eliminate endogenous peroxidase activity with 3% hydrogen peroxide in PBS for 20 min at room temperature.
Wash samples twice with PBS for 3 min.
Eliminate non-specific protein binding by incubation with NPS blocking buffer for 30 min at room temperature.
Remove NPS blocking buffer.
Add mouse anti-human collagen type I antibody diluted 1:100 in PBS containing 0.1% BSA.
Incubate overnight at 4°C.
Wash samples twice in 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 3 min.
Wash samples in PBS for 3 min.
Add secondary antibody (DAKO LSAB+ kit).
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Wash samples twice in 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 3 min.
Wash samples in PBS for 3 min.
Incubate samples with streptavidin peroxidase for 15 min at room temperature (DAKO LSAB+ kit).
Wash samples twice in 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 3 min.
Wash samples in PBS for 3 min.
Incubate with DAB solution for 5 min at room temperature.
Wash three times in PBS for 3 min.
Develop.
Rinse gently with distilled water to stop reaction.
Add 1 ml of collagen type I coating buffer per well and incubate at 4°C overnight (for a 24 well plate).
Aspirate the collagen type I solution.
Rinse twice with 1 ml PBS.
Add 1 ml of BSA blocking solution.
Leave at room temperature for 2 h.
Remove solution and rinse twice with PBS.
Add 1 ml PBS.
Culture PC3 and LNCaP cells in growth medium to 50-80% confluence.
Aspirate medium.
Wash once with PBS.
Rinse gently with 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS (5 ml/75 cm² culture flask).
Add 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS (5 ml/75 cm² culture flask).
Gently agitate flask periodically.
Monitor cell detachment with a microscope periodically (detachment can take up to 40 min).
Centrifuge cells at 370g for 5 minutes to collect cells.
Resuspend collected cells in 10 ml of growth medium.
Remove an aliquot of cells for counting.
Add cells to OBM in growth medium at 1-2x10^4 cells/cm^2.
Culture at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Rinse OBM plus prostate cancer cells three times with PBS.
Incubate with FDA staining solution (2 μg/ml) at 37°C for 15 min in the dark.
Rinse cells three times with PBS.
Incubate with PI staining solution (20 μg/ml) at room temperature for 2 minutes in the dark.
Rinse cells three times with PBS.
Add PBS to immerse samples.
Visualize samples with a fluorescent microscope.
Take images immediately.
Remove PFA-fixed matrices from 4°C.
Add 1 ml of 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS per well in a 24-well plate.
Incubate for 20 min at room temperature with gentle rocking.
Wash twice for 5 min with 1 ml of PBS at room temperature while gently rocking.
Add 700 μl of rhodamine-conjugated phalloidin staining solution to each well in a 24-well plate.
Incubate for 1 h at room temperature with gentle rocking.
Wash twice for 5 min with 1 ml of PBS at room temperature while gently rocking.
Add 700 μl of DAPI staining solution to each well.
Incubate for 40-50 min at room temperature with gentle rocking.
Wash twice for 5 min with 1 ml of PBS at room temperature while gently rocking.
Visualize with a fluorescent microscope.
Aspirate medium and wash once with PBS.
Add 0.5 ml of 0.05% trypsin/0.05 mM EDTA per well in a 24-well dish.
Return to incubator and incubate at 37°C.
Periodically agitate flask gently.
Monitor cell detachment periodically with a microscope.
Assist cell removal from the OBM by mechanical disruption using a standard pipettor and a 1000 μl tip during digestion.
Inactivate trypsin by adding 1.0 ml of growth medium.
Transfer the solution to a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge cells at 1000 g for 5 min.
Wash cells in 1 ml PBS.
Centrifuge cells at 1000 g for 5 min.
Freeze the cell pellet or resuspend it in an appropriate solution (e.g., for RNA extraction).
